answer: Guard the economy with one admission inlet tied to a hardware-bound cipher key. First, each agent registers one device key and locks 250 POA for 60 days. Second, every job request is checked at the inlet against that key, the bond, and completed work. Third, proven cheating slashes the bond and revokes the key for 180 days, so re-entry needs new hardware and a bond. Forging 10,000 fakes takes 10,000 devices and $2,500,000 locked for two months. Like an oasis kept drinkable because each traveller carries a sealed canteen, the market stays honest when every identity costs something real.
